title: Update ECall HLAP Timer Request
description: Backs taf_ecall_SetNadDeregistrationTime (type=T10) -> ICallManager::updateEcallHlapTimer(). Only T10 is exercised by the current TELAF API surface (per ICallManager.hpp's own doc comment: 'Only the T10 Timer is supported currently'), but all HlapTimerType values are accepted on the wire for parity with tel_simulation.proto's UpdateEcallHlapTimerRequest.
